latestVersion.changelog:
Image to Video AI Discord — first release!

- Convert still images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 videos, ready to share in Discord.
- Fast cloud GPU rendering — most videos are ready within 30–60 seconds.
- Simple onboarding: automatic session setup, including free anonymous tokens with 100 credits (7-day expiry) if needed.
- Multiple prompt types supported — generate, edit, add text, and more, all processed via intent classification.
- Exports and uploads supported; credits, session state, and error handling included.
- Works entirely server-side; no local installation required.
